acceptance: No Go identifier for the count says shell unless it means a claude shell only.
A snapshot or signal written before the change still reads the same count (a test pins the old key).
100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Rename the Go symbols to the concept (for example BackgroundJobs and BackgroundCountRegex). Version or keep the panewatch JSON key and the observer `shells` event field so that readers of older snapshots and signals keep working; read each reader before you change it.
source: console review of PR #1846, architecture-reviewer finding 3 and code-reviewer MINOR
summary: PR #1846 made panestream.RunningShells read agy background tasks (`· N task(s)`) as well as claude shells, through the manifest field shell_count_regex. The Go names (RunningShells, PaneProfile.ShellCountRegex, panewatch.Frame.Shells), the manifest key and the observer event field `shells` still say shells. The review of #1846 recorded the rename as a follow-up because it changes the panewatch snapshot and the observer wire field.
title: The pane count of running background work is named for the concept, not for claude shells
